For the dataflow strategy, I'll need to pass the `--dataflow-graph-file` argument as well. Let me write the wrapper script now.

content.text: 写 wrapper 脚本。注意 train.py 在 `training/` 子目录下，策略映射需调整。

input.command:
cat > /root/structfuse/run_m2_early_pilot.sh << 'SCRIPT'
#!/bin/bash
# M2 Early Pilot: 3 strategies × 1 seed (42) sequential training
# Data: partial M1 (24 repos), model: Qwen2.5-Coder-3B LoRA
set -e

source /root/miniconda3/etc/profile.d/conda.sh
conda activate base

DATA_DIR="/root/autodl-tmp/structfuse/m2_early_pilot_data"
OUT_BASE="/root/autodl-tmp/structfuse/checkpoints/m2_early_pilot"
MODEL="Qwen/Qwen2.5-Coder-3B"

declare -A STRATEGY_MAP
STRATEGY_MAP[random]="random"
STRATEGY_MAP[embedding]="embedding_distance"
STRATEGY_MAP[dataflow]="dataflow_aware"

for TAG in random embedding dataflow; do
    STRATEGY="${STRATEGY_MAP[$TAG]}"
    echo "=========================================="
    echo "Starting strategy: ${TAG} (${STRATEGY}) at $(date)"
    echo "=========================================="
    
    TRAIN_FILE="${DATA_DIR}/train_${TAG}.jsonl"
    OUT_DIR="${OUT_BASE}/${TAG}_s42"
    
    EXTRA_ARGS=""
    if [ "$TAG" = "dataflow" ]; then
        EXTRA_ARGS="--dataflow-graph-file ${DATA_DIR}/dataflow_graph.json"
    fi
    
    python /root/structfuse/training/train.py \
        --model-name ${MODEL} \
        --train-file ${TRAIN_FILE} \
        --val-file ${DATA_DIR}/val.jsonl \
        --output-dir ${OUT_DIR} \
        --hard-negative-strategy ${STRATEGY} \
        --learning-rate 2e-5 \
        --temperature 0.07 \
        --batch-size 8 \
        --num-epochs 3 \
        --num-negatives 7 \
        --hard-negative-ratio 0.5 \
        --use-lora \
        --gradient-checkpointing \
        --max-seq-length 2048 \
        --seed 42 \
        --eval-steps 500 \
        --save-steps 1000 \
        --wandb-project structfuse \
        --wandb-run-name "m2_early_${TAG}_s42" \
        ${EXTRA_ARGS}
    
    echo "Strategy ${TAG} completed at $(date)"
    
    # 只保留 best checkpoint，删中间 checkpoint 节省磁盘
    if [ -d "${OUT_DIR}/best" ]; then
        find ${OUT_DIR} -maxdepth 1 -name "checkpoint-*" -type d -exec rm -rf {} + 2>/dev/null || true
        echo "Cleaned intermediate checkpoints for ${TAG}"
    fi
done

echo "=========================================="
echo "All 3 strategies completed at $(date)"
echo "=========================================="
SCRIPT
chmod +x /root/structfuse/run_m2_early_pilot.sh
